scope: Second official-source event, course metrics and GPX status review of top-level events 79-83

events.name: Swiss Alps 100
events.gpx: Official 2027 site provides course pages and GPX download links for the 50K and Matterhorning, with course details published for the 160K/100K as well. New finding: the Matterhorning detail page lists 33.30 km/4,692 hm, but its aid-station table totals 30.40 km (four 7.60 km loops); this distance discrepancy must be resolved before importing the GPX. The 2027 event is confirmed and Matterhorning is a one-time 10th-anniversary race.
events.followUp: Download each official course GPX and parse it; ask organizer to clarify Matterhorning's 33.3 km vs 30.4 km inconsistency.

events.name: Allgäu Panorama Marathon
events.gpx: Official organizer confirms 20th edition on 8 August 2027 and a new Saturday reverse half marathon. The official page currently does not expose a public GPX download. Third-party 2027 course listings disagree on the exact ultra distance (69 vs 69.5 km) and list elevation values that should not be promoted to confirmed organizer data; keep them provisional pending official course profiles.
events.followUp: Check official course pages as 2027 details are published; request official GPX and confirm exact ultra distance and hm.

events.name: Last Soul Ultra
events.eventDates: 2027 World Series; Germany final in August 2027
events.gpx: Official Season 3/2027 page confirms one 6.706 km loop with hourly starts and no fixed finish distance. The official World Series page gives qualifier windows and Germany final in August 2027, but venues for several qualifiers are not yet announced and no public GPX download was found.
events.followUp: Request the exact venue-specific loop GPX once each venue is announced.

events.name: Karnisches Ungetüm

The official organizer page remains the primary source for route confirmation; direct GPX binary and current-version metadata were not downloaded/validated in this pass.
events.followUp: Extract the official 2027 GPX from the organizer page and verify both distances against parsed track length/elevation.

events.name: TREK Matterhorn Ultraks

The organizer's existing route pages/GPX links remain associated with 2026; do not accept them as 2027 files. Treat the 2027 date, course list and GPX versions as provisional until organizer confirmation.
events.followUp: Wait for organizer's own 2027 announcement and fresh course/GPX files; resolve date and course-format discrepancies.
